_comment: Kinds of water, the water layer's ids (0: as the ground category says; a category with no water default keeps the engine's own). colour: the deep colour, left out - the engine's own (sea, lake and river differ); turbidity 0 clear .. 1 opaque, left out - the engine's own; scum: film and duckweed on the surface; foam: times the water's own; emissive: glow of the colour. A river through several categories changes along its course, blended over 256 m like the ground.
